$comment: With withoutDsl, read as a file that cannot call the DSL: its short helpers (signalNames in the catalog) are somebody else's. The signals a file declares (signals: collectSignals, sorted), defines (definitions: collectSignalDefinitions, sorted) and declares from a value it cannot read (encoded: the definitions that are * or name a class, in order). Where each definition is written (declarations: signalDeclarations, in source order, each the name and the text at its offsets). Every name of definitions but * and the class entries has a declaration, and no declaration names anything else. Read by SignalsTest.kt and signals.test.ts.
